definitions.explanation: Managing to do something by a very small margin, with difficulty.

examples.japanese: {辛|かろ}うじて⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→ごうかくする：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
{辛|かろ}うじて⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→まにあう：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I just barely made it in time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→じこ：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辛|かろ}うじて⟦{避|さ}けた→さける：02109_sakeru⟧。

notes:
{辛|かろ}うじて is an adverb meaning "barely" or "narrowly," emphasizing that something was achieved with great difficulty.

USAGE:
Implies that failure/disaster was very close and success came only by a small margin. Often used for near-misses or last-minute saves.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {辛|かろ}うじて⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→まにあう：01142_maniau⟧: to barely make it in time
- {辛|かろ}うじて⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→ごうかくする：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to barely pass
- {辛|かろ}うじて⟦{逃|のが}れる→のがれる：10425_nogareru⟧: to narrowly escape
- {辛|かろ}うじて⟦{助|たす}かる→たすかる：01956_tasukaru⟧: to barely survive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぎりぎり→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧: just barely (more casual)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧: finally, at last (emphasizes effort)
- ⟦なんとか→なんとか：01126_nantoka⟧: somehow, barely
- {辛|かろ}うじて: barely (emphasizes small margin)
